name: Illusory Truth Effect
definition: Repeated exposure makes a claim seem truer without new supporting evidence.
boundary: Repeated independent evidence differs from repetition of the same unsupported claim.

source_variants.name: Illusory Truth Effect (Yanılsamalı doğruluk etkisi)
source_variants.definition: A repeated statement seeming credible through familiarity, without being tested.
source_variants.coverage_reason: No named mechanism, required state or observation model is implemented in the original Mesa sample.
